## Biography & Summary
Sudarshan Sunil Hadmode is an Indian full-stack developer, prompt engineer, and startup founder based in Pune, India. He is the Startup & Founder of Team Alum and the developer of Alumni AI, an advanced AI system with multiple operational modes and an integrated browser powered by Chrome.

## Key Projects & Ventures
- **Team Alum** (https://team-alum.vercel.app): Digital ecosystem and official platform engineered with vanilla web standards, Supabase, and Row Level Security (RLS). Startup & Founder: Sudarshan and Soham.
- **Alumni AI** (https://alumni-ai-teamalum.vercel.app/): Flagship AI assistant featuring Artifact Studio for live interactive code preview, autonomous web research powered by Chrome, and multi-modal reasoning.
- **Atlera Timer** (https://atlera-timer.vercel.app/): Minimalist, distraction-free study and deep-work focus timer with ambient soundscapes.
- **Prompt Engineering Blueprint** (https://teamalum-bookstore.vercel.app/): Technical bookstore and comprehensive publication on prompt engineering and LLM integrations.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Artificial Intelligence**: Prompt Engineering, LLM Architecture, Context Windows, Multi-Mode Reasoning, Tool Calling, Autonomous AI Agents.
- **Frontend Development**: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 (Glassmorphism, Claymorphism, Keyframe animations), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Canvas API, Web Audio API. Zero framework bloat.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Row Level Security (RLS), RESTful APIs, Vercel Edge Runtime.
- **Design & UI/UX**: Motion design, user experience optimization, responsive design systems.
